_doc: Principals of arc 7. Every visual fact here is either locked (see locks.json) or declared as inference or staging. Nothing is anglicised: cloth is woven, cut from the loom and draped, never tailored. Ornament comes from the relief vocabulary. Skin is never lightened and fair-equals-good coding is forbidden outright.

design.age_reading: old. The lateness of his fatherhood is the point of M3 and must be legible in the face.
design.build: heavy through the shoulders, gone soft. A body that was a warrior's.
design.hair: grey, oiled, bound at the nape. No crown in the private hall.

garment.lower: antariya - unstitched cloth, draped and tucked, falling to mid-calf
garment.upper: uttariya - a single length over the left shoulder
garment.construction: draped. Cut from the loom. Not tailored, not sewn, no fitted seam anywhere.
garment.weave: fine cotton, undyed to pale ochre

items: broad flat torque at the base of the throat
plain armlets, high on the upper arm
heavy ear ornament distending the lobe
ornament.rule: Relief vocabulary. Flat planes, broad forms, worn into the body. Never a jewellery-shop object with faceted stones.

design.age_reading: old, but not soft. A king who became an ascetic and kept the bearing.

garment.lower: bark-cloth or coarse undyed cotton, draped short
garment.upper: one length across the chest, often off the shoulder

ornament.rule: The absence of ornament is the characterisation. Do not add.

design.age_reading: a boy under sixteen by his father's statement. Not a young man. Not a hero yet.

complexion_claim.note: The project makes NO claim to a source-mandated complexion for Rama. The gate blocks CLAIMING one. It does not block depicting him: he may be shown under an approved design like any principal. Any code or copy that reads this as 'Rama may not be drawn' is wrong.

garment.lower: antariya, draped short as a boy's

ornament.rule: Less than his father's. He is not yet the court's centre.
Matches Rama's register, one step plainer.

design.age_reading: old, settled, unhurried. The house priest, not a visitor.
